abstract: |
  In this video I showcase my submission for the Game++ Community Challenge #3,
  my second competitive programming challenge.
  Back when I was 14, the landscape of game development and competitive
  programming was quite different from today. Tools and resources were not as
  readily available, making it a unique experience to participate in such
  challenges.
  I was especially proud of integrating the gamepad api into my JavaScript game.
  This required more "low-level" programming compared to what I was used to
  previously. In fact, this was (and possibly still is?) kinda unique for web
  games, as most web games rely on keyboard and mouse inputs.
